The agent collected all necessary details including contact information, service address, and service preferences, and informed Thomas that the team will follow up to confirm the appointment. The call concluded successfully with no issues.

The after-hours assistant, Evie, informed him that cancellations cannot be processed immediately but assured that the request would be passed on to the team for follow-up on the next business day. John confirmed the appointment details and ended the call after the assistant acknowledged his request.
